cache_methodology: Warm/unspecified OS cache; independent experiment lanes run concurrently on a shared host. Timings are diagnostic, not isolated throughput measurements.
notes: Matched adaptive precisions and absolute bounds. Geometry and antenna group boundaries are explicit. Frequency-segment experiments vary only segment length relative to amplitude-64. All decoded outputs undergo WSClean imaging separately.
